noProjectsText: Create a project in Hostwerk or add a folder – an Obsidian vault, for example.
emptyTitle: No graph for this project yet
emptyText: Hostwerk reads code, docs and notes and builds the graph from them. It usually takes seconds and runs entirely on your computer.
findPlaceholder: Find a class, function or file …
canvasLabel: Graph: drag to move, mouse wheel or +/− to zoom, arrow keys to pan, 0 to reset. The list shows the same as text.
centralHint: The most connected ones – a good place to start.
question: Your question
askHint: Ctrl+Enter asks. Claude asks the same questions through the connection.
explainPlaceholder: Name of a class or function
answerHere: The answer shows up here – with files and lines.
openQuestionsHint: The graph found nothing for these. A memory entry helps next time.
reportHint: Claude reads this overview with graph_report.
review: Learned by Claude – please have a quick look
reviewHint: Claude remembers important insights on its own. Confirm, change or delete them.
entryLinks: About (names from the graph, separated by commas)
noSecrets: No passwords or keys – they are rejected.
obsExportHint: Hostwerk only writes into the subfolder “Hostwerk-Graph”. Whatever you change there in Obsidian stays when you export again.
obsFolder: Vault folder (or a new, empty folder)
obsSyncHint: Memory notes you edited in Obsidian move back into Hostwerk.
obsVaults: Add a vault to the graph
obsVaultsHint: Your notes become part of the graph: [[links]] connect them with each other and with the code. The vault is only read.
obsVaultsSaved: Saved – the notes are included the next time you update.
obsImportHint: Pick notes from a vault that Claude should know as knowledge about this project.
obsKept: You changed {n} notes – they stay as they are.
mcpOff: Claude isn't connected to Hostwerk yet
mcpOffText: Connect Claude Desktop or Claude Code first – then Claude can ask the graph.
connectHint: So that Claude knows the graph exists, Hostwerk puts a short note into the project. Nothing more.
optClaudeMd: A short marked section at the end – the rest of the file stays exactly as it is.
optAgents: The same for Codex, Gemini CLI, Zed and others.
optSkill: Its own skill folder with instructions for Claude Code.
pauseHint: Claude then only gets the note “paused” and works as usual. Nothing is deleted.
forgetHint: Removes everything Hostwerk wrote into the project for Claude and then checks that nothing is left. Your own content stays.
forgetMemory: Delete what Claude learned about this project
forgetObsidian: Remove the Obsidian export (only notes you didn't change)
forgotLeft: Almost done – a few things stayed
safety1: The knowledge graph never touches Claude's own settings – no settings.json, no hooks.
safety2: CLAUDE.md only gets one marked section of at most 3 KB. Before saving, Hostwerk checks that nothing else changes.
safety3: Every change goes into a change log. “Forget” undoes exactly those changes.
safety4: Answers to Claude are kept short so its context doesn't fill up.
safety5: Pausing switches Claude back to “as usual” right away, without deleting anything.
dragHint: Drag cards into another area – or pick area and type at the bottom of the card.
focusCut: trimmed – fewer steps show more detail
narrowHint: Folders or patterns with * and **, comma-separated. Tests and build folders count less anyway unless you ask about them.
readModeHint: How precisely Hostwerk reads the code. Automatic = precise (tree-sitter) from 600 code files, otherwise fast.
preciseHint: Read with tree-sitter: definitions and calls from the real syntax tree.
